_provenance.method: Only fields read by tools/prepare_game_data.py, extracted from executed original initializers. Full captures remain optional local research.

10.enemyTable: Initialize [0,1,2,3,4,5]; perform 100 swaps at two independent rand()%6 indices per swap; use first 4 on even dayIndex or first 3 on odd dayIndex
postShuffleRandomCallsInOrder: If rand()%3 != 0: allowedEnemyPrefix=0; enemyPrefixGrowthPerSecond=0.1f; otherwise retain prefix growth and reset prefix20
If rand()%3 == 0: Init SAME artefact slot6,type7,(150,236),upgrade0; overwrites preceding placement when both trigger

12.nonrandomFields: Use extracted daily records, which retain enemy-table entries left untouched by partial original writes

endlessAndMadness.enemyTable: N=effectiveDay>10 ? 11 : min(effectiveDay+1,10). Overwrite first N slots with0..N-1; preserve tail. Perform100 random swaps within first N using two rand()%N per swap. Then tableLength=4 even if N<4.
postShuffleRandomCallsInOrder: If rand()%4==0: allowedEnemyPrefix=0; enemyPrefixGrowthPerSecond=0.1f. Otherwise retain prefix growth and reset prefix20.
If effectiveDay%15==14: Init slot6,type7,(-150,236),upgrade0. If effectiveDay%10==9: Init SAME slot6 at(20,236), overwriting prior placement.
endlessAndMadness.mirrorLevel: Player+0x238 preference copied to mirror flag every initializer
endlessAndMadness.madnessDoorRule: SetupNewLevel0x20a54-0x20a6c raises inventory door tier to1 when currently<=0
endlessAndMadness.newGameBackground: normalGame::InitMode0x20e98-0x20ebc chooses rand()%4 once for an endless/madness new game
